description: Dataset in municipal strategies for food waste collection in Portugal is published by Mendeley Data. The study compiles municipal food-waste collection methods, targeted sectors and service arrangements. Its stated coverage is Portugal; a survey and official-source review covering 308 municipalities. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is CC BY 4.0. A research compilation; response gaps and source years need the study documentation. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
